summary: Palvella Therapeutics filed an 8-K under Item 8.01 announcing Nasdaq approval to transfer its common stock listing from the Nasdaq Capital Market to the Nasdaq Global Market, effective May 13, 2026. The ticker symbol PVLA remains unchanged. This is a routine listing-tier upgrade, not a special situation. No acquisition, divestiture, activist campaign, strategic review, tender offer, going-private, capital return, spin-off, rights offering, restructuring, liquidation, delisting, issuer tender, deal termination, SPAC event, or forced management change is disclosed. The filing reports an operational administrative event with no deal terms or transactional structure.
